優位に立つことが出来る。

最早生产的冲锋枪之一。在其悠久的历史中，从军队、警察到匪徒、
游击队和中国军阀，几乎人人都在使用它。

它使用与M1911相同的大口径弹药。虽然射速不算突出，

因此，无法与盾牌配合使用。

此型号经过改装，可容纳弹鼓，显著提升了弹药容量。因此，
它无需频繁装填，相比使用标准弹匣的型号具有战术优势。

eng_reference:
One of the very first submachine guns ever produced. In its long and storied history, it has seen use by everyone from armies and police forces to gangsters, guerrillas and Chinese warlords. 

It uses the same large-caliber ammo as the M1911. While its rate of fire is nothing spectacular, it makes each shot count with devastating firepower.

The M1928A1's elegant design makes it easy to handle, in effect helping to improve its accuracy.

However, it is unusually heavy for a submachine gun and takes two hands to wield properly; thus, it cannot be used with a shield.

対空迎撃手段としては出色の性能を示し、アメリカを始め数多くの自由主義

ミサイルの誘導方式はパッシブ式赤外線。
攻撃ヘリの空襲に対して有効なカウンターを与えるには最適の武器。
対空戦闘が予想されるミッションでは是非とも装備に加えたい。

锁定时间，使你能更快应对与敌人的突发交战。

会让目标失去意识。

A non-lethal weapon that delivers a 1.5 million volt electric shock to the target, overloading their motor neurons and rendering them unable to move. Shocking the target long enough will knock them unconscious.

By making use of conducting materials (water, metal), it can be used to shock more distant targets as well.

Charging the rod takes a short while, so it cannot be used multiple times in a row. Keep this in mind when facing multiple enemies.

Useful when going for a no-kill completion, or when ammo is running short for your other weapons.
